title: Permutation transport of a prefix set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $A$ and $B$ be subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ with equal cardinality. For any $k$ from $0$ through $n$ and any permutation $\pi$ of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the set of indices whose images under $\pi$ composed with the inverse of the permutation transporting $A$ to $B$ are less than $k$ equals $B$ if and only if the set of indices whose images under $\pi$ are less than $k$ equals $A$.
